parties: Chemplast Sanmar Limited vs. Symed Labs Limited
headline: Chemplast Sanmar denies acquisition of Symed Labs
sum: Chemplast Sanmar Limited issued a formal rumour-denial under Regulation 30(11) SEBI LODR, denying reports of a definitive agreement to acquire Symed Labs Limited. The denial was filed as an intimation to stock exchanges on 24 August 2026.
implication: The Regulation 30(11) denial establishes that no material agreement existed as at the filing date; counsel advising on any subsequent Chemplast–Symed transaction must establish independent due diligence and document that any future agreement is arm's length and material-event-gated, given the prior market denial.
detail: Chemplast Sanmar Limited, a listed pharmaceutical and specialty chemicals manufacturer, formally denied via NSE intimation that it had entered into any definitive agreement to acquire Symed Labs Limited. The denial was filed under Regulation 30(11) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR), 2015, which requires listed companies to immediately correct or clarify any material news that may be misleading. No transaction value, consideration structure, or conditions were disclosed, as the company categorically denied the transaction.
